content.title: Today’s weather: it gets worse
content.text: Skip to contentWATERTOWN, New York (WWNY) - The sun is shining and the winds have abated, for the time being, in the north country.Enjoy it while you can.After wind gusts of up to 60 miles an hour pummeled northern New York overnight, prompting some schools to delay opening and causing a few hundred peope to lose power, our weather has settled down.But by mid-afternoon today, it will be a different story.A strong cold front headed our way will drop our temperature from the mid-60s down into the 20s. That 40 degree drop will be accompanied by rain - there’s a small chance the rain could be severe, so plan accordingly - and then, as it gets colder, snow. And the winds will pick up again - so the high wind advisory for Jefferson and Lewis counties runs through 8 PM.How much? It looks now like up to six inches along Tug Hill, less in lower-lying areas like Watertown.THe rest of our week? Rainy, snowy and cold.
